title: How Many SIMs Are on My Aadhaar? Check on Sanchar Saathi and Report Ones You Don't Use
seoTitle: How Many SIM on My Aadhaar: Check & Report on Sanchar Saathi
seoDescription: Check every SIM issued in your name on Sanchar Saathi in 2 minutes, report unknown numbers, and know the 9-SIM limit (6 in J&K, NE) and penalties.
excerpt: The exact Sanchar Saathi steps, what each reporting option triggers, DoT's August 2026 rules that enforce the 9/6 SIM cap, and the penalties for excess and fraudulent SIMs under the Telecom Act.
